mapper.insert: insert into ai_summary (student_info_id, school_year, term, summary_text, summary_type, create_time, update_time) values (#{studentInfoId}, #{schoolYear}, #{term}, #{summaryText}, #{summaryType}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update summary_text = values(summary_text), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, student_info_id, school_year, term, summary_text, summary_type, create_time, update_time from ai_summary where student_info_id = #{studentInfoId} and school_year = #{schoolYear} and term = #{term} and summary_type = #{summaryType} limit 1
select id, student_info_id, school_year, term, summary_text, summary_type, create_time, update_time from ai_summary where student_info_id = #{studentInfoId} order by update_time desc, id desc
